description: This file contains internal common utilities, templates, and class definitions related to container node handles in the Abseil C++ library, including concepts for transparency, key argument handling, and node handle management.

classes.name: node_handle_base
classes.description: Base class for node handles managing resource transfer and destruction for container elements.

classes.name: node_handle
classes.description: Template class for node handles in sets and maps, specialized for mapped types.

classes.name: CommonAccess
classes.description: Struct providing access to internal node handle functions like get slot, destroy, reset, transfer, and construct.

classes.name: InsertReturnType
classes.description: Template struct representing the result of an insert operation, including position, success flag, and node.

methods.name: IsTransparent
methods.description: Trait to determine if a type is transparent (has is_transparent member).

methods.name: KeyArg
methods.description: Template to select key argument type based on transparency.

methods.name: node_handle_base
methods.description: Manages node handle lifecycle, including transfer, destruction, and reset.

methods.name: node_handle
methods.description: Handles node operations for set and map containers, with specialization for mapped types.

methods.name: CommonAccess
methods.description: Provides static methods for internal node handle operations.

methods.name: InsertReturnType
methods.description: Stores the result of a container insert operation.
